iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

SSL::sessionsecret
       Return data about SSL handshake master secret.

SYNOPSIS
       SSL::sessionsecret

DESCRIPTION
       Return data about SSL handshake master secret.

RETURN VALUE
       SSL::sessionsecret
	   Returns the current SSL handshake master secret.

VALID DURING
       CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE SERVERSSL_HANDSHAKE

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE {
	    log local0. "ClientSSL: Secret for [SSL::sessionid] is -> [SSL::sessionsecret]"
	}
	when SERVERSSL_HANDSHAKE {
	    log local0. "ServerSSL: Secret for [SSL::sessionid] is -> [SSL::sessionsecret]"
	}

	Sample log output:
	: ClientSSL: Secret for 0a2ab9cb944a147b173641e1e9db54e0ac09d6a26a00ea468eda1c4607648700 is -> 03038ad67cc5e78f0de0125d06fb0908ac018c22f457c9f915f1bc425347f86021b40f50bb7369a867c9a99aa897f85c
	: ServerSSL: Secret for 0a2ab9cb944a1478173641e1e9db57e0f5a5cd3433acf1de8eda1c4607648059 is -> 03d4584cd4251f8b911dfc9798017630f0f1b39e41e40e47f0dc0df73249b898d867b0b2567858b4767b353478ad6922d10e3c1a1cd471bc12e3b44bbe6524e9

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.
